source.text: Part B3 only: Have advanced (i.e., metastatic or locally recurrent where local therapy with curative intent is not possible) non-squamous or squamous NSCLC.
Part B3 only: Have advanced (i.e., metastatic or locally recurrent where local therapy with curative intent is not possible) non-squamous or squamous NSCLC.

Part B1 only: Histologically confirmed diagnosis of locally advanced, unresectable (not amenable to curative surgery or radiation therapy) or metastatic clear cell RCC (including those with sarcomatoid features).
Part B2 only: Histologically and/or cytologically documented metastatic adenocarcinoma and squamous carcinoma of GC/GEJC.
Untreated brain metastases that are symptomatic or large (e.g., greater than 2 cm).
Treated CNS metastases who are not neurologically stable or on steroids or anticonvulsants within 2 weeks before initiating IMP of this study.
Have at least one measurable lesion based on RECIST v1.1.

Part B3 only: Have no actionable genomic alterations, such as Epidermal Growth Factor Receptor mutations, anaplastic lymphoma kinase rearrangements, or other genomic alterations for which targeted molecular therapies are available.

Have a history of allogeneic hematopoietic stem cell transplantation or organ transplantation.

Part B3 only: Have experienced relapse or progression during or after treatment with standard systemic therapy including platinum-based chemotherapy and/or immune checkpoint inhibitor in the advanced/metastatic setting or discontinued from prior therapy due to intolerance.

Part B3 only: Participants must have received 1 to 3 or more lines of systemic treatment, which can include anti-PD-1/PD-L1 therapy (if PD-L1 positive), chemotherapy, and anti-angiogenic agents.
